summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing that it will report second quarter 2026 financial results on August 6, 2026, after the close of the US market. The press release confirms no conference call will be held and directs investors to the company's website for materials. This is a routine earnings schedule announcement with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or restructuring. The filing is purely informational and procedural, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions disclosed.
